h: My grading take, plain as I can say it.
t: Most cards don't need a slab. They need a sleeve. Grading is for the card that's already special — the one where the grade changes the story.

h: Three designs. Three keepers. One problem left.
t: The black tees. The new ForeverHumans designs looked right on white and green the second they landed.
Three hundred seventy-three cards, out of the old tracker and into Collectr. The old app did its job. But a collection you can't find things in is just a pile with extra steps.

h: The mail is slow right now. Your card is probably fine.
t: Here's what I tell myself when a plain envelope takes its sweet time. A one-ounce letter rides the same trucks as everything else. Three to five days is normal, not lost.

h: eBay just launched an AI listing scanner.
t: I tried it. My scanner stays. It couldn't nail the exact printing — set, number, variant — and that's the whole job for me.

h: The house goes quiet. The sort table wakes up.
t: One lamp, one stack, nobody watching. The kids are down, the day job's done, and this is the hour the store actually grows.
